Join the Movement

From Under the BQE to the R-I-T-Z.

Dylan Cercone knows what it means to build from nothing—and what it takes to start again.

An only child, raised by a single mother, with limited resources, he was still surrounded by champions  going on to be a 2004 New York State Champion in high school hockey  Later experiencing homelessness in Queens and Brooklyn before working his way to Wall Street, a six-figure career, and a Manhattan penthouse.

But reaching the top changed his definition of success.

Dylan eventually stepped away from Wall Street and returned home to Buffalo. He taught special education, coaches football at an inner-city public high school, and built a food truck business. Different rooms. Different responsibilities. The same commitment to helping people move forward.


His path continued through medical-device territory management, orthopedic operating rooms, and entrepreneurship. Those experiences shaped more than his résumé. They shaped how he leads: set the standard, build trust, and follow through especially when the pressure is on.

Today, as Founder and President of Cercone Group, Dylan brings those lessons to the stage, the sideline, and the boardroom. Through speaking, coaching, and consulting, he helps leaders and teams strengthen communication, take ownership, and perform when people are counting on them.

His story isn’t simply about how far he’s come. It’s about what he does with the experience and who he helps move forward.


Know the difference. Cercone Group.

Through his work with flag football, he helps guide program operations while promoting awareness of mental health, suicide prevention, CTE, and concussion protocols.

THE FOUR SIGNATURE TALKS

Building What Doesn't Exist Yet

Founders, sales leaders, and operators. Built from Dylan's own frontier work — commercializing new tech, scaling Wall Street expansions, and turning territory into system.

Don't Let Your Eyes Adjust to the Dark

Resilience, mental health, and post-loss leadership. Dylan's AFSP-tier keynote on suicide prevention, grief, and refusing to abandon yourself. Delivered to 3,000+ in Buffalo, 2026.

Trust Under Pressure

Executives, med-device teams, financial-services leaders. How disciplined communicators earn trust in high-stakes rooms — and turn it into a durable competitive advantage.

The Cercone Standard

Athletes, coaches, and young leaders. An eight-part code of self-command, integrity, and service — the exact standard Dylan gave to his Canisius Crusaders and McKinley Macks football teams.
